searchText: i get a twitter update via email every day. for some reason, it gives me tweets by tony paul all the time. i don’t follow him, but damn it if twitter doesn’t trick me into going and looking at his stuff when they send me the updates. he rted it and said she’s also one of the nicest people in the world.  chris iott
